text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I'm not aiming for anything in particular
right
now.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Y'know. We just figured it's not time to
make a
decision yet. So, nothing's set in
stone.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ooh! ☆ You're the same as me, then!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...You big liar.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
You do have something you're aiming
for, and
you get the chance to try.

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, did you see Nakayama's interview
after the
Satsuki Sho?!

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
I saw it! She said something like, "Don't
give up so
easily," right? So cool!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Yeeeah, coool.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Everyone wants to see it happen. We've
got the same dream, so let's chase it
together. Let's go all
in, reality be
damned.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I'll give you hope. Just wait for the
Derby.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Get out. Did you seriously say that in
front of
everyone, Nakayama?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
What "hope" are you even talking
about?
Everyone around you is saying
it's impossible,
right?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I mean...

text_block_list.name: Infirmary Staff
text_block_list.text: Please understand, Tosen Jordan.

text_block_list.name: Infirmary Staff
text_block_list.text:
This injury isn't something we can
overlook. I'm really sorry to say it, but
you'll need to refrain
from racing during
your classic year.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
...Tosen Jordan. To be injured at such a
critical
time... How terrible...

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
She had the potential to achieve great
results.
But now, for the rest of the
year...

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: It'll be impossible.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
If everyone around you says it's
impossible, then
impossible is what it is!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Hey, let's go watch the Derby together!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, we have to study up for when we
enter the Derby
ourselves one day!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
This sucks. It sucks. It sucks,
it sucks, it
suuuucks...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I've got nothing! No goals, no hope!
Nothing!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: All I can do...

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
It's almost time for the Japanese Derby!
The
annual celebration of Umamusume
racing is about
to begin!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Gonna give us all hope, yeah? I'll
believe it when I
see it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's a 2,400-meter race on turf and is
said to be the oldest event in the Triple
Crown tour. It stands as one of the great
summits that young racers aspire to
reach.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
We're at the halfway point of the Triple
Crown
tour—the Derby.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. What I need to do is right in front
of me.
choice_data_list: Let's show the world what you're r...
Let's show the world what you're r...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it's just as you say... That's the
plan
anyway.
choice_data_list: Become a Derby Umamusume, and your...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: So, Trainer, did you see it?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
What the public is saying about me.
Make sure
you add it to your database!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's likely talking about the article
that
came
out the other day.

text_block_list.name: Magazine Article
text_block_list.text:
Special Feature: Umamusume Aiming for
the
Global Top Spot - The Oaks
Umamusume Steps
Forward.

text_block_list.name: Magazine Article
text_block_list.text:
Will her ambition surpass the future
Derby
champion's? All eyes are on the
Tiara Tour!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We didn't foresee this turbulent period,
but
there's no turning back now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We started this fight with the intention
to win.
Backing out was never an option.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so begins the Japanese Derby, the
second
battle of the Classic Triple
Crown.
